comment: Accepted vulnerability exceptions for the instance images (design 0004 §7). Each entry: id (CVE/GHSA), image (worker|tools), reason, expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days ahead). The CI job `supply-chain` fails on a critical or high finding with a fix available unless it is listed here and not expired; scripts/check_images.py refuses expired or open-ended entries.

exceptions.reason: Node.js 22.23.4 binary in the one-shot operator container (no listening socket, runs only the mandato CLI). Fixed in node 22.23.5, published 2026-11-11: the lock's 14-day rule allows it from 2026-11-25; bump infra/images/lock.json and the tools Dockerfile then and remove this entry.
